headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2024, back when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW TNT Title as Adam Copeland vs. Christian Cage battled it out in an I Quit match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.10 ? an excellent showing ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. It marked Christian Cage's 10th match with the title on the line. In the third and most brutal chapter of their trilogy, Copeland won an I Quit match filled with hockey jerseys, ladders and handcuffs, finishing Christian Cage with a low blow and a shot from his barbed-wire weapon Spike to win the TNT Championship.

Turning the clock back to 2024: a new champion was crowned for the AEW Continental Title as Kazuchika Okada vs. Eddie Kingston battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.68 ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. Okada shocked the world in his first singles match since signing, tricking Kingston with an eye rake before nailing the Rainmaker to win the AEW Continental Championship in his AEW debut.
It was 2024 when Hook vs. Chris Jericho locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 4.44.
